title: 第2439章 少爷不要第2438章 延寿果
content_zh:
“虽然这延寿果对我们没有太大的用处，但是由于其汁水饱满、清甜，所以对于其他动物，尤其是那些个带羽翼的鸟类来说，是非常极品的食物，若能吃上那么一个的话，不亚于我们吃上龙肉！”
李落耐心的给萧菲姚解释着。
见后者听得专心。
他继续道：“通常情况下，由于惧怕阳光的原因，延寿果果树一般长在深山老林的树荫之下，而又由于照射不到充足的阳光，通常一颗果树上不会接很多，现在咱们面前这一棵果树枝丫上挂满了延寿果，简直是一种奇观。”
稍作停顿，李落又道：“想来是因为这些白雾的原因，才会出现这样的情况吧。”
这些话，把萧菲姚说得心动了。
她当即便站将起来，打算朝那延寿果果树走去，看样子是准备摘那么一两个来尝尝鲜。
哪知走没有两步。
另一边坐着闭目养神的赵丰突然睁开眼睛。
然后用一种生硬的口吻问道：“菲姚小姐这是要做什么？”
萧菲姚理所应当的回道：“摘个果子尝尝。”
那赵丰闻言忽地站将起来，并伸出一手拦住了萧菲姚。
“菲姚小姐，上次我同大少爷见到那红羽鹤的时候，它便是站在那棵延寿果果树上，你现在过去，若万一那红羽鹤正好要过来，这不是被你吓跑了吗？”
不等萧菲姚接话。
赵丰冷脸道：“耽搁了大少爷的事情，这个责任到时候由我，还是由菲姚小姐你来承担？”
萧菲姚闻言皱起眉头道：“有这么巧的事情？”
赵丰似笑非笑道：“有时候，巧合就是来得这样突如其然，我劝菲姚小姐还是老老实实的坐着为好。”
这赵丰当真一点面子都不给萧菲姚。
然而后者却也没有多说什么。
只冷冷瞥了一眼赵丰后，就重新回到了刚才的位置。

李落其实内心很清楚，这种豪门里的养女或者养子，大多都没什么地位。
可被一个护卫一般的人物如此对待，他心头还是有些不舒服的，特别是在萧菲姚陪了自己好几日的情况下。
所以等萧菲姚刚一坐下。
李落便压低声音，用气声说道：“萧小姐，要不要我帮你出口恶气？”
萧菲姚双眸颤了颤，显然有些心动。
思索须臾后，她同样用气声回道：“前辈打算怎么帮小女出这口恶气？”
李落神秘一笑：“这你就不用管了，老朽只需要小姐答应我，不管待会儿出了什么事情，你都要替老朽说话就好。”
萧菲姚闻言斜眼瞥向那边坐着的赵丰，后者也正好在用那种略显不屑的眼光望着自己。
于是想了想后。
萧菲姚点头道：“今天，小女就跟李前辈站在一边又何妨？”
李落笑笑，并点了点头。
红羽鹤是一种需要靠运气才能见到的异鸟，不然萧易行也不会在爬了数十次鹤来山后才见过其两次。
所以现在李落等人，需要的是耐心。
而与此同时。
破庙内的萧易行正准备在草席上睡上一觉。
可是由于身上一直在冒虚汗，他翻来覆去怎么都睡不着。
多次尝试未果后。
他干脆坐将起来。
然后自言自语道：“奇了怪了，难道真的是吃错药了？还是说服用那补力丸的时间跨度太久，已经失去效果了？”
content_en:
"Although this longevity fruit is not of much use to us, because of its full juice and sweetness, it is a very good food for other animals, especially those birds with wings. If we can eat such a fruit, it will be as good as eating dragon meat for us!"
Li Luo patiently explained to Xiao Feiyao.
Seeing that the latter listened attentively.
He continued: "Normally, due to fear of sunlight, longevity fruit trees usually grow under the shade of old forests in deep mountains, and because there is not enough sunlight, usually one fruit tree does not receive many. Now the fruit branches in front of us are covered with longevity fruits, which is simply a spectacle."
After a short pause, Li Luo added: "I guess it's because of the white mist that this situation occurs."
These words moved Xiao Feiyao's heart.
She stood up immediately and planned to walk towards the longevity fruit tree. It seemed that she was going to pick one or two to try.
I don't know that there are only two steps to take.
Zhao Feng, who was sitting on the other side with his eyes closed and concentrating, suddenly opened his eyes.
Then he asked in a stiff tone: "What is Miss Feiyao going to do?"
Xiao Feiyao replied as expected: "Pick a fruit and try it."
Upon hearing this, Zhao Feng suddenly stood up and stretched out his hand to stop Xiao Feiyao.
"Miss Feiyao, the last time the young master and I saw the red-feathered crane, it was standing on the longevity fruit tree. Go over now. If the red-feathered crane happens to come over, wouldn't you scare it away?"
Xiao Feiyao didn't wait for the answer.
Zhao Feng said coldly: "I have delayed the eldest young master's affairs. Will I or you, Miss Feiyao, bear this responsibility?"
Xiao Fei and Yao frowned when they heard this and said, "Is there such a coincidence?"
Zhao Feng said with a half-smile but not a smile: "Sometimes, coincidences just come so suddenly. I advise Miss Feiyao to just sit down and be honest."
This Zhao Feng really didn't give Xiao Feiyao any face.
However, the latter didn't say much.
After only giving Zhao Feng a cold glance, he returned to his previous position.
Li Luo actually knew very well in his heart that most adopted daughters or sons in such wealthy families had little status.
But being treated like this by a guard-like figure made him feel a little uncomfortable, especially when Xiao Feiyao had been with him for several days.
So when Xiao Fei and Yao Gang sat down.
Li Luo lowered his voice and said angrily: "Miss Xiao, do you want me to help you vent your anger?"
Xiao Feiyao's eyes trembled, obviously a little moved.
After thinking for a moment, she replied in the same angry voice: "Senior, how do you plan to help my little girl get out of this bad mood?"
Li Luo smiled mysteriously: "You don't have to worry about it. I just need the young lady to promise me that no matter what happens later, you will speak for me."
Upon hearing this, Xiao Fei and Yao glanced sideways at Zhao Feng, who was sitting over there, and the latter happened to be looking at her with a slightly disdainful look.
So after thinking about it.
Xiao Feiyao nodded and said: "Today, it doesn't matter if I stand with Senior Li."
Li Luo smiled and nodded.
The red-feathered crane is an exotic bird that requires luck to see, otherwise Xiao Yixing would not have seen it twice after climbing the crane dozens of times.
So what Li Luo and others need now is patience.
And at the same time.
Xiao Yixing in the ruined temple was preparing to sleep on the straw mat.
But because he was sweating all the time, he tossed and turned and couldn't fall asleep.
After many unsuccessful attempts.
He simply sat up.
Then he said to himself: "This is strange. Did you really take the wrong medicine? Or did you take the tonic pills for too long and have lost their effect?"
